kyc.label: Identity requirement not yet verified
kyc.note: Current official PayGo materials do not give the MVP enough evidence to state a universal passport/ID requirement for overseas buyers.

roamingSms.label: International roaming SMS supported with wallet balance
roamingSms.note: Ultra Mobile PayGo supports voice, SMS and MMS roaming through the PayGo Wallet. Destination-specific send/receive rates apply and PayGo does not include data roaming.

wifiCallingAbroad.label: Wi-Fi Calling abroad not yet verified for this MVP route
wifiCallingAbroad.note: Do not assume Wi-Fi Calling can replace roaming until the PayGo-specific rule is verified.

numberDuration.label: Renewable carrier line with 30-day service cycles
numberDuration.note: Ultra PayGo is a recurring carrier service. The base charge is deducted every 30 days while sufficient wallet balance is available.

termination.label: Missed renewal can suspend service and eventually cancel the number
termination.note: Ultra’s full PayGo terms say an account below the $3 renewal minimum can remain suspended for up to 60 days; if the balance is above $0 but below $3, an additional 30-day extension can apply. If the balance is $0 after 60 days, the account is cancelled without that extension. The simpler PayGo FAQ says the account and number are cancelled if no payment is made 60 days after the last payment. Treat the full terms as the detailed rule and restore service early rather than relying on the edge of the grace window.

activationFlow.label: Official PayGo physical-SIM activation uses the SIM ACT CODE
activationFlow.note: Ultra’s PayGo activation page asks for the 11-character ACT CODE from the back of the SIM. A third-party pre-activated eSIM is therefore a different activation/ownership path and should not be treated as equivalent.

fairPriceCheck.label: Acquisition price varies sharply by channel
fairPriceCheck.note: The $3 / 30-day charge is service renewal, not the SIM acquisition price. The provider-linked sealed-SIM reference was $13 but observed unavailable; a third-party sealed-SIM listing was $53.85 delivered before tax. Pre-activated eSIMs are a different product/ownership class and are not compared as identical.

data.caveat: $3/30-day service is cheap; initial acquisition/activation path matters.
data.evidence: Current rules; setup path still has gaps

data.summary: The MVP has verified international roaming support but has not yet verified a definitive initial-activation geography rule for overseas buyers.
data.outsideHomeNote: If you are outside the US, treat initial activation as unverified until the provider's current rule is confirmed.

data.inactivity_window: PayGo service runs in 30-day cycles. If the wallet balance is below the $3 recurring-charge minimum at the cycle end, service is suspended.
data.clock_start_or_reset: Activation or successful $3 monthly renewal starts the next 30-day cycle. During suspension, adding enough credit to meet the $3 minimum renews service for the next cycle.
qualifying_activity: Maintain at least $3 in the PayGo wallet for the recurring 30-day charge.
Add credit during suspension so the balance reaches the $3 renewal minimum.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Calls, texts and data usage do not substitute for the $3 renewal charge.
A positive balance below $3 does not restore active service.
Voice/Text or Data Passes do not work on suspended or cancelled accounts.
data.lowest_cost_documented_action: Fund the recurring $3 PayGo service charge for each 30-day cycle. If new wallet funding is needed, Ultra’s documented Auto Renew denominations begin at $5, with $3 applied to the monthly renewal.
data.safest_documented_action: Enable Auto Renew with a valid card and enough wallet balance so the $3 recurring charge succeeds each cycle; do not rely on the suspension window.

minimum_expected_cost.note: A fresh Auto Renew top-up denomination may be $5 or more; unused wallet value remains separate from the $3 service charge.

recommended_buffer.basis: Product-side buffer before the 30-day renewal boundary.

data.grace_or_rescue_window: Up to 60 days suspended. If balance is above $0 but below $3 after 60 days, the detailed terms provide an additional 30-day extension. If balance is $0 after 60 days, the account is cancelled without that extension.
data.termination_and_recycling: Ultra says the account and phone number are cancelled when the applicable grace path ends. The cited terms do not state the exact number-recycling timetable.
